summary: Cadeler A/S filed Form 6-K announcing that Cadeler Limited (to be renamed Cadeler plc) filed a Form F-4 with the SEC for a potential redomiciliation from Denmark to the UK via a 1:1 share-for-share exchange offer. No final decision made; board and management to remain. Terms not yet finalized; a combined EU/EEA prospectus expected. Watch for board decision on proceeding and exchange offer details; risk-arb angle on shareholder approval and regulatory clearances.
